propositions: Changing a ticket's type does not invalidate its stored plan-review verdict, causing stale PASS or BLOCK results to be replayed under criteria the new type is not exempt from
Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) gate on material fingerprint and code SHA but never compare ticket_type, allowing type-mismatched attestations to reuse
Type is material to review scoring: bug, session_log, code_review, and identity tickets are exempt from certain criteria that non-exempt types must satisfy
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so type comparison requires no schema change, only reading the stored value in both reuse paths

The fix adds a type-change guard that returns None (triggering a full re-review) only when both stored and current types are truthy and differ, preserving reuse for sidecars written before this change or with missing type
